tools.name: get_charter_route
tools.description: Look up a published Cuba Te Espera charter route by origin and destination IATA code. It never returns live availability, schedules, or fares.

tools.name: search_published_charter_flights
tools.description: Search published Cuba Te Espera charter outbound flight cards by airport route and departure date. Returns public advertised prices, baggage policy details, and availability categories only; no booking, package, fare, or seat is guaranteed until booking confirmation.
